messages.content: Let’s finish Naples. Before anything is charged, recheck the dates and flight times for both of us, then give me the complete total. The airfare quote expires tonight, so that should be booked first.

The trip is for two travelers, Saturday, August 25 through Friday, August 31, 2029. The nonstop outbound leaves MSP at 4:55 p.m. and arrives at RSW at 8:42 p.m. local time. The nonstop return leaves RSW at 1:35 p.m. and arrives at MSP at 3:47 p.m. local time. Airfare is $1,086 for both travelers. The hotel is $2,718 after tax, and the compact rental car is $438 including taxes, for a combined planned total of $4,242.
Good. That arrival means the earlier 7:15 hotel arrival estimate was wrong, correct?

Correct. With an 8:42 p.m. landing, baggage pickup and the rental-car counter, a realistic hotel arrival is approximately 10:05–10:25 p.m. The hotel needs the late-arrival note and the lockbox instructions must be obtained in writing before arrival day.
Right. Are the traveler names and birth dates still the ones already entered for me and my partner? No changes to either.

Yes. Both travelers’ saved legal names and dates of birth are attached to the airfare checkout, with no changes. The itinerary is August 25–31 and the flight times match what I just reviewed. Shall I place the $1,086 airfare charge now?

The nonstop round-trip flights are confirmed for both travelers at $1,086 total. The ticketing receipt and airline confirmation have been issued. Next is the hotel: partial Gulf-view king for six nights at $2,718 after tax, card guarantee only, payment at check-in, and free cancellation through August 20. I will add the 10:05–10:25 p.m. arrival and request written lockbox instructions. Proceed?
Proceed with that room. Keep the chair package off.

The hotel is confirmed for August 25–31 in the partial Gulf-view king. The total remains $2,718 after tax, with no beach-chair package added. The reservation notes the late arrival after 10 p.m. and requests written lockbox instructions because the desk closes at 9 p.m.
Now the compact car. Make sure the pickup information uses the actual flight arrival, not the old hotel estimate.

The compact rental is set for RSW pickup on August 25 at 9:15 p.m., tied to the arriving flight scheduled for 8:42 p.m. Return is August 31 at 11:30 a.m., ahead of the 1:35 p.m. departure. The quoted total is $438 including taxes. May I complete it?
Yes. Book it, then reconcile what is paid now versus later.

The compact car is confirmed at $438 including taxes, with the flight number and 8:42 p.m. arrival attached to the reservation. The car charge is due under the rental confirmation rather than included with the airfare or hotel.
Give me the final status in one pass, including anything I still have to do.

All three reservations are confirmed for two travelers, August 25–31, 2029. Flights: nonstop MSP–RSW round trip, $1,086 charged now; outbound arrives at 8:42 p.m. and return departs at 1:35 p.m. Hotel: partial Gulf-view king for six nights, $2,718 after tax, guaranteed by card and payable at check-in, with free cancellation through August 20; no chair package. Rental car: compact at RSW, $438 including taxes, with 9:15 p.m. pickup and 11:30 a.m. return. The planned total is $4,242. The remaining action is to obtain and retain the hotel’s written lockbox code before arrival, since expected check-in is around 10:05–10:25 p.m.
